provenance.clock: trace ts/dur are µs since the Host's monotonic origin; tied to the wall clock by the 70 `present` spans and presentation.pieceAtMs (median offset -1794753635985 ms, residual min -134 / max 8 ms)

spans.trace: r62-run-trace.json traceEvents[] (ph X), converted to run-relative wall ms
spans.wait.model: r62-session.jsonl assistant records [timestamp - message.durationMs, timestamp]. The Host emitted no `wait.model` span in this run, so this family is the run's own provider records - its seam is Pi's and is not re-derived here
spans.wait.idle: r62-result.json presentation.activity.points: each `idle` point to the next non-idle point. That is the condition CompanionLoop publishes as COMPANION_ACTIVITY idle and CompanionHostService opens wait.idle on, so this is the span the Host would have emitted

provenance.expected: computed here by interval union over the wall clock (AUDIT.md §1 / partition.mjs's method), independently of attributeWaitBudget
